summary: StageLink Iteration 3 — Profile Management module fully validated. Backend (7/7 pytest passed, 1 skipped): PATCH /api/profile/musician correctly updates only provided fields without clobbering others, returns {ok:true, updated:N} (multi-field patch of 4 fields returns updated=4). All new MusicianProfileIn fields accepted and persist: tagline, professions[], skills[], languages[], willing_to_travel, travel_radius_km, state, country, spotify_url, soundcloud_url, website_url, linkedin_url, facebook_url, apple_music_url, visibility, hide_pricing/location/contact. POST /api/profile/portfolio returns item with id + created_at and appears in profile; DELETE removes it. POST/DELETE /api/profile/services same flow. GET /api/profile/completion returns {completion: int 0-100, suggestions:[{field,prompt,weight}]}. Frontend (Playwright, mobile 390x844): login as ariya.kapoor -> /profile -> switched active_role to musician -> Profile tab renders tagline (TEST_all_new_fields), Edit profile + Share buttons, role switcher (Musician/Organizer), stats bar (Rating 5, Reviews 1, Reliable 64%, Followers 0), About text, Professions chips (Vocalist, Songwriter) in brand color, Style/Genres (Jazz/Soul/Vocals), Skills (Harmony, Stage presence), Base rate section. Tapping edit-profile-cta correctly navigates to /profile/edit. All 19 checked testIDs present on edit screen (tagline-input, bio-input, city-input, travel-switch, ai-bio, new-port-title/url, add-portfolio, new-svc-title/desc/price, add-service, vis-public/followers/private, edit-save-cta, exp-input, price-input, avatar-url-input). AI bio button populated bio field with 113-char AI-generated text. Adding a portfolio item (TEST_UI_port) via add-portfolio worked and appears in the list. Adding a service (TEST_UI_svc, PricingType=per_event, 9999) via add-service worked and appears in Services list. Visibility chip switches (Public/Followers/Private) and hide_pricing switch render and are interactive. completion-card is not shown for ariya because her completion is now 100% after backend field-fill tests — spec says '(if <100%)' so this is correct. Minor backend issue: DELETE /api/profile/portfolio/{id} for a non-existent id returns {deleted: 1} because the $set of updated_at always triggers modified_count>=1 (see RCA).

minor.issue: Response {deleted:N} is derived from update_one().modified_count. Because the same update also sets updated_at, modified_count is 1 even when the $pull matches nothing. So a delete of a non-existent id returns {deleted:1} misleadingly. Suggest computing deletion from array length before/after or using a two-step check.

issues: Save success toast (testID=edit-ok) exists in code but was not observable in Playwright — likely cleared quickly or state never set. Consider a persistent toast/snackbar for 1.5–3s so users get positive confirmation.
Bottom-tab buttons lack testID props (Tabs.Screen in (tabs)/_layout.tsx). Testers must use /profile deep link. Adding testID='tab-<name>' to each Tabs.Screen would harden e2e.

action_items: (Minor backend fix) In DELETE portfolio & services handlers, compute deleted count from array length change (or split into two update_one calls: first the $pull, then the updated_at $set) so {deleted} is accurate.
(Minor frontend polish) In /profile/edit saveAll(), ensure msg='Saved!' remains visible ~2s (setTimeout to clear) so testID=edit-ok is observable and users see confirmation.
(Testability) Add testID props to Tabs.Screen entries in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx so future e2e can tap tabs directly.
(No action needed) Everything else in the Profile Management spec works as expected.

rca_of_issue: DELETE endpoints for portfolio/services return {deleted: 1} even for non-existent ids because MongoDB update_one().modified_count reflects that updated_at was $set, not just whether the $pull matched. Repro: `curl -X DELETE .../api/profile/portfolio/does-not-exist -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'` -> {deleted:1}. Mitigation: split into two ops, e.g. `res = await db.musicians.update_one({'user_id': u['id']}, {'$pull': {'portfolio_items': {'id': item_id}}}); deleted = res.modified_count; await db.musicians.update_one(..., {'$set': {'updated_at': now_iso()}})` — or compare array length pre/post.
